what: the outer top edge of a tube with a 1 mm wall (r 9..10, 20 high) filleted 1 mm: the round spans the whole wall top and meets the inner wall at its edge; truck refused it
method: the round removes the corner region (1 - pi/4) r^2 (r = 1) at the outer top edge; by Pappus its centroid is at radius 9 + (1/6)/(1-pi/4) = 9.7766: V = pi*(100-81)*20 - 2 pi 9.7766 (1 - pi/4). The top annulus is used up, so the faces are the outer cylinder, the round, the inner cylinder and the bottom = 4
